title: Bounded representation domain
requirement: WHEN a ReferenceState is offered to the bounded representation adapter, it SHALL return a MachineImage Bounds F related by RepresentationRelation or an explicit out-of-domain result.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Complete pending-state encoding
scenarios.when: An in-domain factorial state retains a pending multiplication, caller environment and a helper cursor.
scenarios.then: Partial encode/decode retain code references, ordered frames, control, reachable structural values, active lengths, fuel/work, outcome and helper state under the selected field/layout/capacities. A value outside those capacities has no represented-image claim; immutable sharing unfolds to structural occurrences and physical identity is not source equality. Encode/decode and circuit correspondence remain unimplemented/unproved.

expected.out-of-capacity value: no represented-image claim; sharing unfolds to structural occurrences

unasserted: the lane encoding itself (lanes_sha256 not recomputed independently; only injectivity, state-determinism and the capacity threshold are asserted)
decode equality is the adapter's own flag, cross-checked against the fuel-limited reference state; encode/decode and circuit correspondence are asserted to remain unproved/unimplemented

exec.entrypoint: mori simulate --execution-profile sherlock-helper-microstep/1 --source-profile moriarty-sherlock-draft/1 --entry (non-native build) with --chunk N --chunk-represent
